all.hint: If checked, all options will be selected without additional prompting.
all.label: Select All

auto.hint: If checked and this has only one option, it will be selected automatically without additional prompting.
auto.label: Automatic

expandFolders.hint: If checked, select from the documents within folders instead of the folders themselves.
expandFolders.label: Expand Folders

expandTables.hint: If checked, select from the documents within tables instead of rolling the table itself.
expandTables.label: Expand Tables

globalIdentifiers.hint: Identifiers for documents anywhere in the world. Identifiers refer to whatever the canonical document is for a given piece of rules text. Does not support tables or folders.
globalIdentifiers.label: Global Identifiers

globalUuids.hint: UUIDs for documents anywhere in the world. UUIDs refer to specific documents. Tables and folders are allowed.
globalUuids.label: Global UUIDs

localIdentifiers.hint: Typed identifiers for documents on the actor this is relative to. Identifiers are kebab-case and have no special characters. They should be of the format {type}:{identifier}.
localIdentifiers.label: Local Identifiers

localQualifier.hint: Include all documents in the actor that meet the qualifier above. If this is non-zero, all documents that are children of the actor executing this will be considered for selection. If the formula entered above evaluates to a truthy value given that document's roll data, it will be included.
localQualifier.label: Local Qualifier

localUuids.hint: Relative UUIDs for documents on the actor this is relative to.
localUuids.label: Local UUIDs

makeSeparateActivations.hint: If checked, every option gets its own button. Otherwise, one button is made that prompts for a selection.
makeSeparateActivations.label: Separate Buttons

multi.hint: If checked, multiple options can be selected to be used at once.
multi.label: Multiple Selection

selectInExecution.hint: If checked, the selection is made while this executes rather than when the button it creates is pressed.
selectInExecution.label: Select During Execution
